title: Toy Quality in Steep Decline
text: It seems like Kitnip toys are declining in quality. Last year I got some of my cat's favorite toys from Kitnip, but I just resubscribed and this box felt like a waste of money. The wand is poorly cleaned and could easily give splinters, and I had to trim multiple strings off of the "t-shirt", a third toy unpictured is a "journal" which when cut off of the carboard becomes a rectangle. The designs don't look super well made. I'll give Kitnip one more box, and if that one is equally bad/worse, I'll change this to 1 star.
label: neutral
